# CertGate evaluation metrics

<!-- GENERATED by `node tools/evaluate/metrics-md.mjs` from the committed Stage 3 evaluation artifacts. Do not edit by hand; `node tools/evaluate/metrics-md.mjs --check` (and `npx vitest run`) fails if this file differs from a fresh generation. -->

Real model, real endpoint: each run read 27 fictitious certificates (cg-004 … cg-030) through AMD Token Factory. Definitions follow register D3-05 as amended by R3.1 C-08 … C-11 and C-15. cg-001 … cg-003 were used to tune the prompt and are excluded from both runs. The two runs are independent: different seats, different clean checkouts, different times. The landing page shows the figures of the implementer run, and names that run.

Candidate commits: each run names the commit it actually ran (below). The accepted Stage 3 candidate is `5c904693`. Between these commits the reading path is identical by diff: the reader's request and parsing, the frozen prompt and the rules. The later commits changed receipt contents (the F1 snapshot and the "as reported by the model" location label), the UI, the upload policy and the tests.

## Reporting rules

- **False conforming** (the grave error): FC-broad = proposal release where the expected proposal is not release, over all cases whose expected proposal is not release. FC-strict = release where the expected proposal is block, over the expected-block cases (C-08). Any false conforming in any real run is a REJECT finding with a root-cause line (C-19).
- **Rule abstention** = proposal review with status processed; **failure** = status error, by class; reported separately, each over all evaluated cases (C-09).
- **Per-field accuracy** compares the model channel with the correct reading of each critical field: correct, unknown, wrong, invented (a value where the field is absent), and **confident-on-illegible** (a confident value where the correct reading is illegible), counted separately (C-10).
- **Seconds and cost per certificate** are over processed cases (status not error), with N; a missing reported cost is unknown, never zero (C-11).
- Requests use **temperature 0** (C-12). The runs are reported side by side, with every per-case proposal difference listed below; a difference is never hidden behind one passing run.
- Receipts and run artifacts carry the endpoint reply's id, created time, model and usage as returned (C-14); GET /usage is read before and after each run and reconciled with the sum of per-reply costs (C-15).
- The tuning cases **cg-001, cg-002 and cg-003** are excluded from the evaluation (D3-03); they are the judge-mode stories.
